audio_description:
A green-lit control mechanism arcs with blue electricity.
An ornate banner-hung deck; a white ring of energy blazes across the floor.
Balamb Garden converts to mobile form.

context.scene_title: Balamb Garden becomes mobile — the academy's internal machinery activates to transform it into a moving vessel (Disc 2, to escape the incoming missiles).
locations: Inside Balamb Garden — a dark mechanical control core crackling with electricity, and the ornate upper deck/master area with banners and a glowing energy ring, the coast/sky visible beyond

characters.name: (none individually visible)
characters.recognition: Interior/mechanical FMV; no character's face is featured.

context.summary: Deep in Balamb Garden, a green-lit control mechanism arcs with blue electricity as the academy's hidden systems power up. The view shifts to an ornate banner-hung deck where a brilliant white ring of energy blazes across the reflective floor — the Garden converting itself into mobile form.
context.context_note: Interpreted as Balamb Garden's transformation into mobile form (Disc 2); the interior machinery and energy ring are clear, but the exact rooms are inferred.
